title: Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions: minimum area per dwelling by site area (grouped dwellings R30-R80 and R80-equivalent codes)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Keyed on site area (of the dwelling, A1). Values identical to Chapter 2 (p10). Site area rounded up to the nearest whole number, so rows ascend with shared endpoints: an exact boundary takes the lower band. Sites under 100 m2 have no row (NOT_APPLICABLE): R100-SL is Table 2.10a (C1.1.3-r100sl). Constants in the rules: 35% maximum roof cover (C1.1.3-r2), 3 m minimum dimension (C1.1.3-r1), behind the street setback area unless C1.1.5 (C1.1.3-r3). Each band is 5 m2 below current Part C Table 1.1a (4 m2 for 100-130).
